findings.title: Top Profit-Contributing Item
findings.claim: During the analysis week (2026-01-12 to 2026-01-19), Spanish Latte generated the highest gross profit of 3513.40 SAR with a gross margin of 70.8%, based on 278 units sold at 4959.00 SAR total revenue and 1445.60 SAR COGS.
coverage_notes: Analysis covers 2157 POS line items (excluding refunds) from 1288 transactions
Menu unit costs available for 18 items with sales
COGS calculated as quantity × unit_cost_sar from menu
assumptions: Menu unit_cost_sar values are current and accurate for the analysis period
POS line_total_sar reflects actual revenue after discounts
No recipe/BOM data available; analysis is at item level only

findings.title: Known Waste Cost in Analysis Period
findings.claim: Total known waste cost for the analysis week (2026-01-12 to 2026-01-19) is 867.10 SAR across 6 items with recorded waste observations out of 6 total inventory records in the period. This represents waste from 151 units across 6 SKUs. 0 inventory records had null/blank waste values and were excluded per methodology.
coverage_notes: Analysis includes 6 items with non-null, positive waste_cost_sar values
Records excluded due to null/blank waste values: 0
Known waste cost represents actual loss value from inventory.known_waste_cost_sar field
Includes only waste_cost_sar values >= 0 with non-null entries; excludes estimated, pending, or flagged waste
assumptions: Waste cost represents actual verified loss value
Null/blank waste values indicate no recorded waste observation (not zero waste)
known_waste_cost_sar field contains only verified waste costs
Analysis scope limited to records with explicit waste cost entries
